title: Travelling Gestures – Elfriede Jelineks Theater der (Tragödien-)Durchquerung
summary: Silke Felber describes Jelinek's theater of (tragedy) traversal for the first time at the intersection of theater, literary, and cultural studies. In the form of a richly detailed study, this foundational work reveals gestures of lamentation and anger that extend back to antiquity while simultaneously pointing toward an uncertain future.
